name: busybar
description: Draw, show pictures and play sounds on your BUSY Bar.

interface.shortDescription: Your status, timers and notes on a BUSY Bar
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex to set your status, start a focus timer, show text, pictures or the weather, and play sounds on your BUSY Bar. Plug it in with USB or keep it on the same Wi-Fi: it is found automatically. Unofficial, not affiliated with Flipper Devices / BUSY.
defaultPrompt: Start a 25-minute focus timer on my BUSY Bar
